system.description:
Declare before rolling, and take Disadvantage on the attack roll (Advantage never cancels it) to aim at the Head, an Arm or a Leg.

  • Only one attack a round can be a called shot.
  • On a hit the target makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or: Head, it is Stunned for 1 round, and a creature that recovers is immune to your Head shots for the rest of the encounter; Arm, it drops what it holds; Leg, its speed is halved for 1 round.
  • Archers and Gunslingers gain it at 4th level; others only with the Mighty Deed of Arms feat.

Combat Manoeuvres, Manoeuvre: replaces one attack.
